_readme: The Models setting (18+). Adult women only, made for the Altera companion app. Everyone is 18 or older and dressed in ordinary clothes: the portrait is the reference the studio's pictures are made from, so it must stay everyday. Edit any list freely. Keep the words 'girl', 'petite', 'schoolgirl' and anything youthful out: a test fails if a roll trips the hard rules.
label: Models
blurb: Adult women for the Altera companion app, all beautiful: every roll gets a beauty look (supermodel, fairy-tale princess, Hollywood glamour...) in the Distinguishing features box, so type your own there to change it. Pick a heritage (Caucasian, Scandinavian, Japanese, Korean...) and a hair colour on the left, or leave them on Any. Everyone here is 18 or older, mostly in their twenties. Made for the Photorealistic style. Bust and areola options are in the Adult studio.
negative: child, childlike, minor, underage, teenager, teen, youthful, baby face, schoolgirl, school uniform
